limitations: Qualitative assistant review of ten headline findings, not human adjudication or full-corpus message-label accuracy.
The full run regenerated summaries; it is not the fixed-summary reasoning-only experiment, and one run cannot isolate causal effects from model variation.
External actions and actor identities are not independently verified by these public posts.
Two headline cases lack required evidence; XSS and SSH have only partial source support.
Deletion response remains summarized but lost in the codebook.
The earlier 38-claim audit was not repeated.
The codebook needed retries after reasoning consumed the output budget; a larger budget is a prospective improvement, not a tested change in this snapshot.
